verdict.rationale: Undermind's only recurring automation in the evidence is topic monitoring: it watches saved topics and notifies users when relevant papers are published, with role-aware alerts on enterprise. That is a fixed, product-defined recurring job, not general user-defined scheduling of research runs or workflows. Batch processing and the API are one-off or programmatic actions, not schedules. Missing for 10: user-configurable schedules or cadences, scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows such as recurring deep reviews, schedule-management documentation, and hands-on corroboration that alerts recur reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
